definitions.explanation: A vehicle equipped to tow or haul other vehicles, typically broken-down or illegally parked cars.
A powered vehicle designed to pull trailers, heavy equipment, or other loads. Includes agricultural tractors and the cab units of articulated trucks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故障|こしょう}→故障：01405_koshou⟧⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{牽引|けんいん}{車|しゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運|はこ}んだ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: The broken-down car was transported by a tow truck.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{牽引|けんいん}→牽引：13498_kenin⟧ (towing, pulling) and ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle). The word covers both roadside-assistance tow trucks and industrial/agricultural towing vehicles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牽引|けんいん}{車|しゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to call a tow truck
- {牽引|けんいん}{車|しゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧: to transport by tow truck
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{牽引|けんいん}{車|しゃ}: large towing vehicle
- {牽引|けんいん}{車|しゃ}⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧: towing vehicle license

SIMILAR WORDS:
- レッカー⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧: wrecker, tow truck — specifically the roadside-assistance type; more common in everyday speech
- トラクター: tractor — the loanword used more commonly for agricultural tractors
- ⟦{牽引|けんいん}→牽引：13498_kenin⟧⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧: towing license — the additional license needed to tow trailers in Japan
